top_choice_rationale: P001 credits a specific, mature and reproduced invention: trapping many neutral atoms at a magic wavelength so that the differential light shift cancels, which took optical frequency standards to the 10^-18 level in several laboratories and species. It has concrete consequences for the redefinition of the second, relativistic geodesy and tests of fundamental constants. The two-name allocation (Katori for the concept and first realizations, Ye for record accuracy and systematic control) leaves no visible hole in the core credit. P002 is also mature and conceptually broad, but its three-name allocation and overlap with the 2016 topological-phases prize make it a close second; either award is better than no award.
recusal_note: Profile documents a long-running collaboration with Anne L'Huillier and Lund attosecond colleagues and work in precision atomic theory, but no documented connection to Katori, Ye, Kane, Mele or Molenkamp; none requiring recusal apparent from profile.
